title: Synctext message 'How long will you be down here for?' with no reception at the Baltic anomaly

tellings.quote: I get a text on my phone and you can ask anybody there with me about this happening and they'll all corroborate this story. And it's a text on Synctext and it says, "How long will you be down here for?"

plain: While visiting the Baltic Sea anomaly, a strange formation on the floor of the Baltic Sea, in a spot with no phone reception, Michels says his phone got a text through the messaging app Synctext that asked: "How long will you be down here for?" He tells this as something that happened to him on the same trip when equipment failed, and says everyone who was with him will back up the story. If true, someone or something knew where he was and could reach him where no signal should get through.
